_doc: Task 6H sections 11-12. Stage H0: overfit 10 canonical same-image counterfactual pairs with the pair objective (per-sample BCE+Dice plus the own-vs-cross region-ranking loss) and measure the H0 gate on the real query-to-heatmap path. A pass is implementation proof for the pair-step semantics only.

head.structure: query: LayerNorm(2048) -> Linear(2048,128); visual: Conv1x1(C,128); heatmap = dot(q, K)/sqrt(128) + scalar bias

budget.note: the scheduler horizon counts PAIR optimizer steps, not record steps

no_gt_leakage_audit.pair_path_inputs: image + instruction + constant [BOX] + one shared frozen SAM2 feature

selection.reason: H0 is a 10-pair implementation proof; its weights are fitted to those pairs, so H1 starts from the same clean Task 6G initialization convention.
